strategies.use_when: Probabilities and consequences are sufficiently calibrated and risk neutrality is defensible.
Future states are deeply uncertain and robust performance matters more than one forecast.
invalid_when: scenario set omits plausible adverse states

strategies.use_when: Policy or strategic choices must remain acceptable across many plausible futures.
invalid_when: only one central forecast is available

strategies.use_when: Decisions can be staged and revised as new evidence arrives.
invalid_when: decision is fully irreversible at the initial stage

strategies.use_when: Additional data collection may change the preferred action.
invalid_when: new evidence cannot arrive before the decision

strategies.use_when: Multiple partially independent actions can reduce concentrated model or scenario risk.
invalid_when: actions share the same hidden failure mode

strategies.use_when: A response should activate only after predeclared, validated indicators cross thresholds.
invalid_when: threshold performance has not been evaluated

strategies.use_when: No option is uniformly optimal and minimum acceptable outcomes and hard constraints are clear.
